files.description: Product specification: source of truth for behavior, roles, business rules (grace period, excusals, pauses, streaks, consistency), privacy rules, non-goals, and open product questions that must not be decided silently.

Architecture baseline: .NET 10 / Blazor Interactive Server / EF Core + SQL Server stack, Clean/Onion layer boundaries between HT.Domain, HT.Application, HT.Persistence and HT.Ui, testing requirements, and deliberately deferred technical choices.
Agent guidance: build/test commands, layer dependency rules, security/privacy boundary (admins must not access private tracking data), testing expectations, and docs/git conventions.
